entities.summary: Gary Lee Usher was an American rock musician, songwriter, and record producer, who worked with numerous California acts in the 1960s, including the Byrds, the Beach Boys, and Dick Dale. Usher also produced fictitious surf groups or hot rod groups, mixing studio session musicians with his own associates. These bands included the Super Stocks, the Kickstands, the Hondells with their No. 9 US pop single "Little Honda", and Sagittarius.
